title: What Is a Soliloquy? — A Literary Guide for English Students and Teachers
skills: define soliloquy as a dramatic device
distinguish soliloquy from monologue and dialogue
analyze how soliloquies reveal a character's private thoughts and motivations
explain how soliloquy contributes to characterization, conflict, and theme
alignment_note: Introduces soliloquy as a dramatic device through which a character reveals private thoughts directly to the audience. Supports drama analysis, characterization, interpretation of motivation and internal conflict, and comparison with related forms such as monologue and dialogue across high school English courses.
